objective: Define a small, real, multi-type Park laboratory demonstration with end-to-end user workflow, strict identity and source provenance, and explicit scientific gates.

scope.target_demo: 30-50 unique confirmed astrophysical source groups, not 30-50 OIDs
scope.labels: ALeRCE reference/weak labels; BTS spectroscopic labels only for its supported transient population
scope.baseline: v0.2.0 and software v1.0.1 remain immutable
scope.existing_demo_limit: The existing v0.5 sample has 30 g-band OIDs from one field/rcid and no confirmed physical-source grouping; it cannot serve as the multi-type demo dataset.

decisions: Do not train or evaluate a classifier on only 30-50 demo objects.
Keep DR24 raw exploration, frozen v0.2 reference inference, and any future DR24-specific model as separate lanes.
Do not feed HMJD into the v0.2 MJD feature contract by renaming columns or applying an unverified conversion.
Preserve DR24 mag, magerr, clrcoeff, catflags and filter/field/rcid semantics.
Show raw scores as raw unless calibration is present and independently validated.
Keep OOD separate from scientific anomaly detection.
Use CONFIRMED identity only for the main 30-50 source count; keep ambiguous/unmatched examples separate.

facts_checked.fact: v0.2 model class order contains 15 classes and no Artifact/Unknown class.
v0.2 feature pipeline requires mjd/fid/mag/magerr; basic features need 10 observations per band, Lomb-Scargle needs 30, cross-band features need both bands.
DR24 HATS uses hmjd, mag, magerr, clrcoeff, catflags; HMJD is HJD - 2400000.5; DR24 mag is calibrated for g-r=0 in AB.
facts_checked.source: Official IRSA DR24 release notes and HATS tutorial

facts_checked.fact: Current ObservationService standard get_observations path uses ALeRCE; DR24 raw acquisition is a separate method/route.
Existing Park Pilot v0.5 contains 30 g-band OIDs from one field/rcid, not 30 confirmed unique physical sources; no DR24 classifier inference was run.
The original v0.2 production model artifact is unavailable/unauthenticated in accessible remote sources; do not substitute lab-smoke artifact.

deliverable: A 5-10-source end-to-end acceptance run and a 30-50-source guided demonstration, with a provenance-rich dataset package and truthful model/calibration status.
gates: Recover/authenticate model artifact and original 150-row snapshot.
Build multi-type 30-50 confirmed source-group manifest; do not count OIDs as sources.
Complete explicit DR24 source selection in Application Service and Workbench.
Validate HMJD/time, photometry, color and QC contracts before feature mapping.
Only run v0.2 inference if original artifact and feature parity are proven.
If needed, define a separately versioned DR24 lab model trained/evaluated on data independent of the 30-50 demo set.
Complete repeatable Workbench run, exports, offline replay, clean environment and evidence report.
acceptance_limits: A 30-50 source demo cannot establish competitive population Macro-F1.
A 30-50 source demo cannot establish generalizable probability calibration or temporal transfer.
ALeRCE labels are reference/weak labels, not independent astrophysical truth.
BTS covers a limited spectroscopically classified transient population, not all 15 classes.
The 100,000-lightcurve scale target remains a later dataset milestone; confirm whether the Park committee requires it before initial acceptance.

tests_run: Downloaded GitHub Actions artifact 13670960922 from run 42611080798
Verified local SHA-256 against GitHub artifact digest
Inspected archive members, query manifests, TSV rows, label distribution and DR24 observation-availability counts

next_action: Resolve coordinates for ALeRCE OIDs from an authoritative catalog endpoint, then create a candidate list with explicit cross-match evidence to DR24 HATS; do not use the current 150+150 tables as a joined dataset.

alerce_reference.role: top-ranked broker reference output; not independent ground truth

source_inventory_audit.conclusion: The ALeRCE and DR24 tables are independent and have no shared crossmatch key or coordinates in the ALeRCE response. They must not be joined by row order or OID. This sample is unsuitable for the multi-type Park demo; retain only as acquisition/provenance evidence.
